# press-kit (wildcard style)

Press kit: a one-page PDF and a five-page PDF, boilerplate.txt (yours to write), a downloads list, logo files, and page previews. No awards, quotes or numbers have been invented.

## Folders

| Folder | What is in it |
|---|---|
| [`logos/`](logos/) | Logos for journalists and venues: wide, stacked and icon, in full colour, black and white, as PNG (4096 px) and SVG. |
| [`previews/`](previews/) | Pictures of every press-kit page. |

## Files

|---|---|---|
